deviations: Extra anchors beyond the brief: sleeper_origin (character placement), head_rest, lie_center on both beds; base_center + carry_grip on bedding_rolled.

lie_down/get_up are in place (root fixed at sleeper_origin) but the body travels about 0.5 m from standing to lying (pelvis moves back onto the bed); the game must place the character root on the bed's sleeper_origin before lie_down and keep it there until get_up ends.
bed_hide_pile and bedding_rolled have no brief triangle budget; self-set budgets 300 and 200 are reported.

HOUSE-002 is not merged on the integration branch, so the demo uses HOUSE-001 only (as the brief allows). The roof-off views keep HOUSE-001's frame/rafters; extra cutaway and frame-hidden views are preview-only.
Transitions keep the torso within ~5 cm of the bedding while sitting up/rolling (hips lift slightly as the legs swing); measured per frame in checks/contact_check.json.
The r002 tunic skirt is skinned to the thighs; in the knees-drawn-up roll poses the skirt panels splay (r002 rig limitation, mesh not edited).
Inspection uses this job's own tools (source/inspect_glb.py etc.), not tools/inspect_asset.py, which does not know batch-8 IDs (not edited).
